en: A colorized panoramic view of a European city nestled between green hills and mountains. In the foreground are villas and buildings with red-tiled roofs surrounded by trees and fields; further back is a denser urban area with church towers. On a wooded hill to the right stands a prominent tower-like structure. At the top left of the image, printed text in German reads 'Graz von der Hilmwarte.'
